● /help
  Start here
  Type a task and press Enter.
  /model        Switch model
  /connect      Connect or reconnect a provider
  /help         List commands and keys

  Primary
  /help         List commands and keys
  /goal         Inspect or control a multi-turn goal
                [OBJECTIVE|edit …|budget N|pause|resume|clear]
  /context      Show context usage or choose a window
                [NAME|default]
  /status       Show session, usage, and workspace status
                [--verbose]
  /model        Switch model
                [PROVIDER/MODEL]
  /details      Toggle bounded live tool detail
  /timeline     Show local turn, child, and recovery history
  /new          Start a fresh session
  /resume       Resume a saved session
                [ID]
  /connect      Connect or reconnect a provider
                [PROVIDER]
  /disconnect   Disconnect a provider
                [PROVIDER]
  /think        Set thinking for the next turn
                [on|off|default]
  /effort       Set reasoning effort for the next turn
                [LEVEL|default]
  /account      Show provider accounts and their usage
                [N]
  /agent        List, inspect, or resume an existing agent
                [ID|resume ID]
  /mcp          Show MCP servers, or trust one so it may run
                [trust NAME]
  /skills       Show indexed skills, or trust one this project ships
                [trust NAME]
  /diff         Inspect workspace changes
                [SCOPE]
  /review       Run a read-only change review
                [SCOPE]
  /undo         Undo the last attributable turn
  /redo         Reapply the newest exact undone turn
  /revert       Selectively revert a file or hunk
                [FILE]

  Advanced
  /diagnostics  Show detailed cache and recovery diagnostics
  /profile      Switch configured profile
                [NAME]
  /provider     Switch provider
                [NAME]
  /quit         Exit Smith

  Keys
  Enter                     Send a task
  Enter while working       Send now
  Tab while working         Queue for after this turn
  Tab when idle             Next profile (empty draft)
  Shift+Tab when idle       Previous profile (empty draft)
  Ctrl+O                    Expand or fold detail
  Esc                       Interrupt or close
  Shift+Enter or Alt+Enter  Insert a newline
  \ then Enter              Replace the backslash with a newline
  Up / Down                 Move between draft lines; browse history and delegated agents from the
                            first or last line
  Home / End                Go to draft start or end; when empty, go to oldest or newest output
  Ctrl+A / Ctrl+E           Go to line start or end
  Alt+B / Alt+F             Move one word left or right
  Ctrl+W                    Delete the word to the left
  Ctrl+U                    Delete to line start
  Ctrl+K                    Delete to line end
  Alt+Up                    Edit the newest queued task
  Ctrl+B                    Move a running shell command to the background
  Ctrl+P                    Open the command palette
  ? on an empty draft       Show shortcuts
  PageUp / PageDown         Scroll the transcript
  Mouse wheel               Scroll the transcript
  Ctrl+L                    Follow the newest output
  Ctrl+R                    Search input history; Enter restores, Esc closes
  Ctrl+C                    Save the draft in history and clear it
  Ctrl+C twice              Exit (press twice within one second)
  @                         Complete files and agents; @@ sends a literal @
  !                         Run a local shell command; !! sends a literal !
  //                        Send text with a leading slash
